description:
A desktop terminal for running multiple CLI agents in parallel sessions.

PATerminal provides parallel terminal sessions, split panes, session resume,
agent status, and Git tools for CLI agent workflows on Windows and macOS.
CLI agents must be installed and authenticated separately.
Official builds include a 30-day trial of all features. Advanced features
require a license after the trial. The source is available under a proprietary license.
Changes
- Automatic group colors alternate red and blue. Groups without a color you chose are colored red, blue, red… down the sidebar in the order they are shown, so neighboring groups never share a color. The order follows creating, moving, collapsing and expanding groups. Colors you picked yourself and "none" are kept. Automatic colors from earlier versions switch to the alternating colors once on the first launch.
- Settings > Color theme has an option to stop coloring new groups. When it is off, new groups are created with no color; existing colors are left as they are.
- The folder is followed right after "Move here". After "Move here" in the folder browser (including the one that opens for a new session) or the change-folder dialog, the sidebar, path bar and Git view follow the shell's new folder right away. Shells that do not report their folder (stock macOS zsh) previously showed the old folder for a few seconds.
macOS Universal and Windows x64 installers are attached by the release workflow. This release becomes Latest after the build and updater signature checks succeed.
